records.text: Owens alleged that many Eastern European models brought through Faith Kates's office were later flown to parties in the Virgin Islands.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And like I said, there were so many Eastern European models that were being brought through her office, many of whom were subsequently then flown to parties in the Virgin Islands.

verification.notes: Current reporting confirms Faith Kates introduced models to Epstein and remained close to him, but no reliable source located verifies that many Eastern European models from her office were flown to parties in the Virgin Islands.
